registered_before: review generation, model training and all new assessment predictions
hypotheses: Counterbalancing length and style within semantic families can reduce nuisance-only sentiment prediction, while regional and episode diversity supplies genuinely different training situations.
Long narratives may benefit from 256 rather than128 tokens; frozen128/256 and staged adaptation compare this on new development only.
Partial adaptation, regularization and class-balanced difficult-case sampling may improve global composition; they can also fail and are not guaranteed to beat TF-IDF.
Separate calibration and policy cohorts may still fail independent ambiguity/risk criteria despite high confidence.

generation.scenario_planner: separate actual agent; metadata only; no historical catalog access
generation.training_development_writers: one original writer per region, no model outcomes, only assigned non-assessment scenarios
generation.assessment_writer: fresh independent agent without inherited conversation, train/development texts or historical outcomes
generation.reviewers: two separate fresh agents see text and random identifier only; no author label, role, model prediction or review from the other
generation.adjudication: coordinator considers author intent plus both independent AI reviews; records disagreement, may quarantine entire family, never invents human gold
forbidden: real identifiable businesses accused of fictional incidents
label words or IDs embedded as artificial sentiment markers
generation.counterbalance: one positive/neutral/negative per scenario family with the same target length band; style/structure rotate independently of sentiment; no common stock endings

data_admission.gate_action: Do not train before admission. Failed gate means explicit quality-blocked pilot, not adjusted thresholds or automatic scale-up. Any pretraining revision gets a new data hash and full audit; never edit observed evaluations.

hard_sampling: Replacement sampling with class-normalized weights so each class has equal total probability; TRAIN tags only, capped multiplier1.5, exactly TRAIN row-count draws per epoch. The hard arm isolates sampling from standard; the regularized arm jointly varies LR/decay/dropout/smoothing and does not isolate their individual effects.
early_stopping: Encoder tune once per epoch, patience1; checkpoint improvement requires Macro-F1 gain>=1e-6, or tied F1 with fewer negative-to-positive, or tied both with NLL reduction>=1e-4. Restore paired best head/encoder and stop at first non-improving epoch. Replicas use selected epochs without tune inference/reselection and preserve the original maximum-epoch LR schedule.
selection: Tune only Macro-F1; ties fewer negative-to-positive, lower NLL, then earlier candidate/epoch. Primary seed42 remains primary; never choose best seed from assessment. Record both best overall and best executed adjusted candidate before assessment; replicas target the latter and all preselected comparisons remain explicit.
comparison: Dummy/LR/SVM/frozen128/frozen256/selected adjusted model on identical new assessment rows; fixed seed replicas for the selected adjusted configuration if feasible. Historical locked V1/V2 training references optional only within budget, never read their evaluated cohorts for selection. No direct claim of improvement across different evaluations.

compute_budget.optional_full_gate: After one timed epoch of the first partial candidate, conservatively project full256 as3x per-epoch time; skip full candidate if projection plus elapsed exceeds development budget. Record skipped as unmeasured, not equivalent performance.
compute_budget.scale_action: Use measured costs and admitted quality to assess 3501-row TRAIN feasibility; do not commit to an unbudgeted multi-hour full grid. Smaller operational first phase is explicitly permitted by user.

target_5000_plan.assessment_rule: All full-scale final450 and ambiguity25 must be newly authored and frozen before full-scale model predictions; never relabel pilot60 as an intact final test. Only pilot TRAIN may be carried into full TRAIN; all new roles preserve family/source/related-episode separation.

limits: All corpus items and reviews are AI synthetic; neither author intent nor agreement between AI reviewers is human validation.
Semantic and lexical audits cannot prove population independence or a lack of generator style.
Regional naturalness and tourism utility are not validated by native human speakers.
Pilot60 assessment and small phenomenon supports are exploratory; once observed they remain frozen.
No model or policy automatically replaces DEMO defaults; all five agents and UI/Whisper/contracts remain unchanged.
assessment_lock: Persist all selected configurations, fixed seed artifacts and calibration/policy choices before assessment. Create exclusive assessment-start marker before the first prediction. Interruption leaves it observed/locked; do not silently rerun or overwrite.
